key_insight: RenalTransLSTM combines LSTM and Transformer layers to predict ICU acute kidney injury earlier and more accurately across multiple future time windows.
clinical_relevance: This could support earlier risk stratification in the ICU, helping clinicians prioritize monitoring and potential intervention for patients at risk of AKI.
method: Trained on 48-hour ICU histories from MIMIC-IV.
Predicted AKI at 6-, 12-, and 24-hour lead times.
Compared against SVM, XGBoost, LSTM, TG-LSTM, and Transformer baselines; used Integrated Gradients and counterfactual analysis for interpretability.
evidence_signal: On 61,735 MIMIC-IV ICU admissions, the model achieved AUROC above 0.90 and F1-scores up to 0.85, with better performance than baseline models across most horizons.
watch_item: The abstract does not show external validation, so performance may differ in other hospitals, workflows, or patient populations.
paper_title: RenalTransLSTM: Multi-Horizon Prediction of Acute Kidney Injury in ICU Patients using a Hybrid LSTM-Transformer Architecture
